title: odd-calendar
description: A month of dates to choose one from: the WAI-ARIA date grid, with the month and buttons to the months before and after above it, and Today and Clear below. The value is a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, submitted under `name` as a native date input submits it. Weeks start on the page language's first day (`first-day` sets it); names come from `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

value.description: Initial date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; the `value` attribute, as on a native date input.

min.description: Earliest date that can be chosen, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

max.description: Latest date that can be chosen, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

required.description: A date is required to submit.

readonly.description: The dates can be moved through but the value cannot change; still submitted, and not validated.

first-day.description: First day of the week, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday) as in `Intl.Locale` week information; 0 follows the page language.

value.description: The chosen date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or empty. Setting it detaches it from `defaultValue`.
